seo.title: About | HWH Consulting
seo.description: Georges D., founder of HWH Consulting: 20 years of hands-on experience in security and performance for retail, luxury, and sports. Audit, training, and conferences.

apropos.name: Georges D.
apropos.intro: 20 years of hands-on experience across retail and security, from sport to luxury: expertise dedicated to protecting and driving the performance of your business.
paragraphs: After more than ten years spent protecting the assets, teams, and reputation of some of the world's largest international retail brands — and just as many years working in retail itself — I founded H.W.H to put that expertise at the service of any organization that needs greater clarity on its security.

My path was built store by store, region by region, up to global responsibilities. I led security and asset protection for groups such as Ralph Lauren, JD Sports, Claire's, and Sunglass Hut, with one common thread: turning a function often seen as a cost into a genuine driver of performance.

At Ralph Lauren, on the Paris flagship store, I brought shrinkage down to under €40,000 in one year and improved security indicators by 19% — overseeing field teams, service providers, and internal investigations alike. At Sunglass Hut, I built the entire security and loss prevention framework from scratch for 110 stores and 5 brands across France and Monaco, from the GDPR register to the security protocol for the 2024 Olympic Games. At both JD Sports and Claire's, I supported dozens of regional and store managers in reducing losses while keeping people at the center. Before that, at Protectim Security Group, I managed up to 200 private security officers for clients such as Primark and Apple.

This diversity of experience — from luxury to fast fashion, from single-brand to multi-brand retail, from the field to management — taught me one thing: there is no one-size-fits-all solution in retail security. Every brand, every store network has its own vulnerabilities, its own priorities, its own operational constraints.

My path was also built on the private security side: I managed more than 200 officers deployed across France, for clients spanning every sector — from supermarkets to top luxury brands. This experience gave me a deep understanding of both sides of the industry: that of the service provider deploying people in the field, and that of the client defining the strategy. It is this dual perspective that gives my consulting its value today.

That conviction is what led to the creation of H.W.H. Today, I work across France and internationally to audit security systems, train teams in loss prevention best practices, and share my experience at conferences dedicated to security and brand protection — in Paris, London, New York, and Milan. My goal remains the same as it was on day one: to give organizations, large or small, the concrete means to reduce their losses and secure their business for the long term.
